The new claim supplies exact shared-function norm, an interior unique minimizer (5-sqrt(17))/4, and an unbounded gap to independently perturbed data amplification. value.rationale: A natural three-measurement quadratic histopolation design gives a sharp and unique measurement-overlap choice minimizing the genuine shared-function perturbation norm. Its extreme mismatch with generalized Lebesgue amplification (diverging at both design boundaries while the actual norm remains bounded) is a structural explanation for correlated measurement robustness. The exact extremizers, determinant, finite norm, and closed optimal parameter are directly reusable as benchmarks and are not mere renamings of a numerical table.
